points.description: Purpose: the significance test checks how well the predicted/fitted model fits the observed data (goodness of fit).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it checks the model or data without mentioning fit.

points.description: Importance: it gives the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis (decides whether to accept or reject the hypothesis) using a statistical test.
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions hypothesis testing without the idea of rejecting the null hypothesis or probability.

points.description: Names the chi-square (X2) test as the test used for the level of significance.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the why (goodness of fit of model to observed data, and rejecting the null hypothesis by probability) and the chi-square test named. Give part marks for a vaguely stated reason. A wrong test name (e.g. t-test, F-test) earns nothing for P3 but does not affect P1 and P2. Total is 2 marks, rounded to whole marks if the exam requires.
